name: Hand ASM
source_adaptations: Made render dimensions a runtime argument so one persisted assembly core supports all benchmark sizes.
Added RAY_STRAIGHT_NO_MAIN and RAY_HAND_ASM selection around the shared C driver and core; Hand C retains the same scene and numerical operations.
compiler:
Apple clang version 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.4)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.1.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

changes.change: Pair the two sphere intersections in float64 SIMD lanes; mask inactive square-root lanes; retain exact arithmetic, plane handling, strict closest-hit order and ties.
Compute the vertical camera contribution once per row and reuse it for all columns.
Avoid redundant Ray copies, reduce traceRay frame from 80 to 32 bytes and tail-call shade, remove unused callee-saved register spills.
Use macOS 11 deployment marker with baseline ARM64 instructions and libc/libm calls.

abi.render: void render(uint8_t *pixels, Camera camera, int64_t imageSize)

precision: float64; no fused multiply-add, no approximate reciprocal or square root, unchanged libm pow
scope: Fixed three-object benchmark scene; arbitrary supported image sizes and camera inputs. Renders complete frames, including recursive reflection and shadows.
timing: Same C timing/checksum driver as Hand C; renderer core linked as persisted assembly; no Nifty invocation.
